Public Function Twice(x As Variant) As Variant
    Twice = x * 2
End Function

Public Function Sum3(Optional a As Variant = 10, Optional b As Variant = 20, Optional c As Variant = 30) As Variant
    Sum3 = a + b + c
End Function

Public Sub Hello()
End Sub

Public Function Plus3(Optional a As Variant = 10, Optional b As Variant = 20, Optional c As Variant = 30) As Variant
    Plus3 = a + b + c
End Function

Public Function Shown(x As Variant) As String
    Shown = TypeName(x) & " " & CStr(x)
End Function

Public Function XFE1() As Variant
    XFE1 = 5
End Function

Public Function AB12() As Variant
    AB12 = 1
End Function

Public Function Kind(which As Long) As Variant
    Select Case which
    Case 1: Kind = CLng(70000)
    Case 2: Kind = "text"
    Case 3: Kind = True
    Case 4: Kind = DateSerial(2024, 1, 2)
    Case 5: Kind = CCur(1.5)
    Case 6: Kind = Array(1, "a")
    Case 7: Set Kind = ThisWorkbook
    Case 8: Kind = CSng(1.5)
    Case 9: Kind = CVErr(xlErrNA)
    Case 10: Kind = CByte(7)
    Case 11: Kind = CDec(2.5)
    Case 12: Kind = Null
    Case 13: Kind = Array(Array(1, 2), 3)
    Case 14: Kind = Array()
    Case 15: Kind = CInt(3)
    Case 16: Kind = Array("a")
    Case 17: Kind = Array(1, ThisWorkbook)
    End Select
End Function

Public Function Raises() As Variant
    Err.Raise 11
End Function

Private Function Tried(ByVal how As Long, ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim r As Variant, o As Object
    r = Empty
    On Error GoTo Bad
    Set o = Application
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Twice", 4)
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Twice", 4)
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Twice", 4)
    Case 1
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Twice", "4")
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Twice", "4")
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Twice", "4")
    Case 2
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Hello")
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Hello")
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Hello")
    Case 3
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Twice")
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Twice")
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Twice")
    Case 4
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Nope")
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Nope")
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Nope")
    Case 5
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run()
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]()
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]()
    Case 6
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Twice", 1, 2)
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Twice", 1, 2)
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Twice", 1, 2)
    Case 7
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Sum3", 1, 2, 3)
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Sum3", 1, 2, 3)
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Sum3", 1, 2, 3)
    Case 8
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("P.Twice", 5)
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("P.Twice", 5)
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("P.Twice", 5)
    Case 9
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run(1)
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2](1)
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2](1)
    Case 10
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Twice", Empty)
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Twice", Empty)
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Twice", Empty)
    Case 11
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Sum3", 1, , 3)
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Sum3", 1, , 3)
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Sum3", 1, , 3)
    Case 12
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Plus3", 1, 2, 3)
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Plus3", 1, 2, 3)
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Plus3", 1, 2, 3)
    Case 13
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Plus3", 1, , 3)
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Plus3", 1, , 3)
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Plus3", 1, , 3)
    Case 14
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("AB12")
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("AB12")
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("AB12")
    Case 15
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Kind", 1)
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Kind", 1)
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Kind", 1)
    Case 16
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Kind", 2)
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Kind", 2)
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Kind", 2)
    Case 17
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Kind", 3)
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Kind", 3)
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Kind", 3)
    Case 18
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Kind", 4)
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Kind", 4)
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Kind", 4)
    Case 19
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Kind", 5)
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Kind", 5)
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Kind", 5)
    Case 20
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Kind", 6)
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Kind", 6)
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Kind", 6)
    Case 21
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Kind", 7)
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Kind", 7)
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Kind", 7)
    Case 22
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Kind", 8)
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Kind", 8)
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Kind", 8)
    Case 23
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Kind", 9)
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Kind", 9)
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Kind", 9)
    Case 24
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Twice", 2.5)
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Twice", 2.5)
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Twice", 2.5)
    Case 25
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Twice", True)
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Twice", True)
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Twice", True)
    Case 26
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("XFE1")
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("XFE1")
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("XFE1")
    Case 27
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("P.Plus3", 1)
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("P.Plus3", 1)
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("P.Plus3", 1)
    Case 28
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run(2.5)
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2](2.5)
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2](2.5)
    Case 29
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Hello", 1)
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Hello", 1)
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Hello", 1)
    Case 30
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Twice", 1.5)
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Twice", 1.5)
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Twice", 1.5)
    Case 31
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Kind", 10)
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Kind", 10)
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Kind", 10)
    Case 32
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Kind", 11)
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Kind", 11)
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Kind", 11)
    Case 33
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Kind", 12)
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Kind", 12)
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Kind", 12)
    Case 34
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Kind", 13)
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Kind", 13)
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Kind", 13)
    Case 35
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Kind", 14)
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Kind", 14)
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Kind", 14)
    Case 36
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("A1")
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("A1")
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("A1")
    Case 37
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Kind", 15)
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Kind", 15)
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Kind", 15)
    Case 38
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Kind", 16)
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Kind", 16)
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Kind", 16)
    Case 39
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Kind", 17)
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Kind", 17)
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Kind", 17)
    Case 40
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Shown", 4)
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Shown", 4)
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Shown", 4)
    Case 41
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Shown", CByte(2))
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Shown", CByte(2))
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Shown", CByte(2))
    Case 42
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Shown", CLng(3))
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Shown", CLng(3))
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Shown", CLng(3))
    Case 43
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Shown", CCur(1.5))
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Shown", CCur(1.5))
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Shown", CCur(1.5))
    Case 44
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Shown", #1/2/2024#)
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Shown", #1/2/2024#)
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Shown", #1/2/2024#)
    Case 45
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Shown", CSng(0.5))
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Shown", CSng(0.5))
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Shown", CSng(0.5))
    Case 46
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Shown", Empty)
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Shown", Empty)
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Shown", Empty)
    Case 47
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Shown", True)
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Shown", True)
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Shown", True)
    Case 48
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Shown", "4")
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Shown", "4")
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Shown", "4")
    Case 49
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Shown", 2.5)
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Shown", 2.5)
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Shown", 2.5)
    Case 50
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Shown", #3:15:00 PM#)
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Shown", #3:15:00 PM#)
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Shown", #3:15:00 PM#)
    Case 51
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Shown", CDate("2024-02-29 13:05"))
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Shown", CDate("2024-02-29 13:05"))
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Shown", CDate("2024-02-29 13:05"))
    Case 52
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Shown", CDec(2.5))
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Shown", CDec(2.5))
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Shown", CDec(2.5))
    Case 53
        If how = 0 Then r = Application.Run("Shown", DateSerial(2024, 12, 31))
        If how = 1 Then r = Application.[_Run2]("Shown", DateSerial(2024, 12, 31))
        If how = 2 Then r = o.[_Run2]("Shown", DateSerial(2024, 12, 31))
    End Select
    If IsObject(r) Then
        Tried = TypeName(r)
    ElseIf IsArray(r) Then
        Tried = TypeName(r) & " " & LBound(r) & " " & UBound(r)
    Else
        Tried = TypeName(r) & " " & CStr(r)
    End If
    Exit Function
Bad:
    Tried = "E" & Err.Number
End Function

Public Function Probe() As String
    Dim s As String, which As Long, how As Long
    For which = 0 To 53
        For how = 0 To 2
            s = s & "|" & Tried(how, which)
        Next
        s = s & "~"
    Next
    Probe = s
End Function
